text:
sqlpipe is a command-line tool that copies Postgres tables to S3 as Parquet files. It connects to a Postgres database, reads a table, and writes the data to S3 in Parquet format. You can run a full copy or a sync that transfers only new and changed rows.

sqlpipe tracks the last synced value for each table, so you can schedule repeated runs without duplicate data. It supports multiple tables in one run, and you can filter columns and rows before the copy. Output files use Snappy compression by default. sqlpipe does not transform data. Use it as the first step in a pipeline, before a query engine like Athena or Presto reads the Parquet files from S3.
